item.name: 回血药剂
item.describe: 装备后每回合恢复5%的血量
item.describe_en: Recovers 5% HP per round after using it.

item.name: 龙鳞
item.describe: 龙身上的鳞片，极为珍贵的材料，只有龙类怪物掉落
item.describe_en: Scale of a dragon,a very precious material used for many purposes. Only drops from drake monsters.

item.name: 普通强化石
item.describe: 强化装备的宝石，大部分怪物都会掉落。
item.describe_en: A stone that enhances equipments. It drops from most of the monsters.

item.name: 魔力之石
item.describe: 神奇的魔法石可以用来重铸装备属性,深渊，黑市中获得。
item.describe_en: Magic Stone is used in reforging the base grade of equipment(common, standard, great, masterwork). Drops from abyss and Shop.

item.name: 复活石
item.describe: 非常珍贵的魔法石，每场战斗仅可使用一次。
item.describe_en: Can be used only once during each battle.

item.name: 地牢钥匙
item.describe_en: Can be used to open the dungeon.

item.name: 宝库钥匙
item.describe: 用来开启宝箱，来源于深渊和商店
item.describe_en: Can be used to open the chest. Drops from abyss and shop.

item.name: 深渊徽记
item.describe: 猎魔勇士挑战深渊获得的荣誉非常珍贵 可用来兑换深渊宝物
item.describe_en: A precious Emblem obtained from challenging abyss. Can be used to exchange for abyss treasure.

item.name: 副本卷轴
item.describe: 用来解除副本封印，进入副本必须物品。BOSS，特殊怪物掉落，黑市中也可获得。
item.describe_en: Remove the seal of an Instance and challenge the monster in it with this scroll. Drops from Bosses and special monsters.

item.name: BOSS召唤卷轴
item.describe_en: Can be used to summon BOSS.

item.name: 魔法印记
item.describe: 受到魔法破坏 但还有着一丝魔法力量
item.describe_en: Effected by magic, It still resonates with magic power.

item.name: 幸运宝箱
item.describe: 开启宝箱有几率获得特殊装备,金币,强化石,燕雀石,火焰之心,沙虫晶核等珍贵的材料
item.describe_en: You have chance to get special equipment, gold, enhancement stone, machalite ore, heart of fire, crystal nucleus and other precious materials.

item.name: 铁矿石
item.describe: 普通的矿石可用来打造武器,来源广泛人类,兽人喜欢收集它
item.describe_en: Iron Ore is used to forge weapons. Can be obtained from everywhere. Humans and orc like to collet it.

item.name: 秘银
item.describe: 稀有金属，用它可以打造出优良的装备,部分Boss会掉落来源广泛
item.describe_en: Mithril is used to forge powerful weapons. Can be obtained from everywhere. Some of Bosses will drop it.

item.name: 燕雀石
item.describe: 极为珍贵的材料，打造史诗级装备必备材料，BOSS，特殊怪物,副本,合成,黑市中也可获得
item.describe_en: Machalite Ore is used to forge epic equipment. Can be acquired from Bosses, special monsters, instances, alchemy and shop.

item.name: 水晶石
item.describe: 稀有材料可用来打造珠宝首饰，来源较广泛(Boss,高级怪物)掉落
item.describe_en: Crystal Stone is used to forge jewelries and accessories. Bosses and veteran monsters will drop it.

item.name: 大地结晶
item.describe: 珍贵的材料打造传说级武器饰品必备材料,部分Boss掉落,黑市也可获得
item.describe_en: Earth Crystal is used to forge legendary equipment. Can be obtained from some Bosses and Shop.

item.name: 翡翠
item.describe: 珍贵的材料用来升级特殊装备,副本,深渊掉落
item.describe_en: Can be used to upgrade special equipment. Drops from instances and abyss.

item.name: 血石
item.describe: 极为珍贵的材料,可用来升级特殊装备,深渊18层以上掉落
item.describe_en: Extremely precious material. Can be used to upgrade special equipment. Can be obtained in the 18th or higher floors of the abyss.

item.name: 牙齿
item.describe: 普通的装备材料，低级野兽类怪物掉落
item.describe_en: Common equipment material. Drops from common beast monsters.

item.name: 骨头
item.describe: 普通的装备材料，低级野兽类怪物掉落
item.describe_en: Common equipment material. Drops from common beast monsters.

item.name: 皮革
item.describe: 普通的装备材料，野兽类怪物掉落
item.describe_en: Common equipment material. Drops from beast monsters.

item.name: 利爪
item.describe: 普通的装备材料，野兽类怪物掉落
item.describe_en: Common equipment material. Drops from beast monsters.

item.name: 鳞片
item.describe: 鳞片，优质材料，蛇，鳄鱼等怪物掉落
item.describe_en: High quality material. Drops from snakes, crocodiles and other monsters.

item.name: 毛皮
item.describe: 优质材料，高级野兽掉落
item.describe_en: High quality material. Drops from veteran monsters.

item.name: 龙翼
item.describe: 极为珍贵的材料，龙类怪物掉落,挑战副本也有低概率掉
item.describe_en: Extremely precious material. Drops from drake monsters. You have a low chance to get it in challenge instances.

item.name: 龙牙
item.describe: 龙的牙齿，极为珍贵的材料，只有龙类怪物掉落
item.describe_en: Fang of a dragon, extremely precious material. Only drops from drake monster.

item.name: 灵魂之尘
item.describe: 优质的材料，骷髅，死灵类怪物掉落
item.describe_en: High quality material. Drops by skeletons and wraiths.

item.name: 邪恶之眼
item.describe: 珍贵的材料，高级亡灵,怨灵掉落
item.describe_en: Precious material. Drops from the undead and spectres.

item.name: 魔法精华
item.describe: 稀有的材料，法师，巫师，祭祀等使用魔法的敌人掉落,部分BOSS也有几率掉落
item.describe_en: Rare material. Drops from witches, priests, wizards and other monsters that use magic. Additionally, some bosses have chance to drop it.

item.name: 天使之泪
item.describe: 极为珍贵的材料,可由特殊装备分解获得
item.describe_en: Extremely precious material. Can be obtained from special equipment decomposition.

item.name: 能量之源
item.describe: 蕴含着神秘魔法能量，极为珍贵的材料
item.describe_en: Extremely precious material. There's a mysterious magic power hidden in it.

item.name: 灵魂结晶
item.describe: 珍贵的材料,深渊掉落,可用来升级特殊装备
item.describe_en: Precious material. Soul Crystal is used to upgrade special equipment. Drop from instances and abyss.

item.name: 沙虫晶核
item.describe: 非常珍贵的材料，死亡沙虫掉落
item.describe_en: Really precious material. Drops from sandworms.

item.name: 元素粉末
item.describe: 稀有材料，精灵祭祀,精灵刺客，火焰怪等怪物掉落，来源比较广泛
item.describe_en: Rare material. Drops from elven priests, elven assassins, flame monsters and other monsters.

item.name: 大骨
item.describe_en: Precious material. Drops from beast Bosses.

item.name: 恶魔之心
item.describe: 非常珍贵的材料，恶魔类怪物(恶魔城主，恶魔猎手)掉落
item.describe_en: Really precious material. Drops from demon monsters (demon lords, demon hunters).

item.name: 火焰之心
item.describe: 非常珍贵的材料，火山巨人掉落
item.describe_en: Really precious material. Drops from volcano giants.

item.name: 虫壳
item.describe: 普通的材料，虫类怪物掉落
item.describe_en: Common material. Drops from worm monsters.

item.name: 巨爪
item.describe_en: Precious material. Drops from beast Bosses.

item.name: 染料
item.describe: 优质的材料，来源广泛僵尸骷髅类怪物掉落
item.describe_en: High quality material. Drops from zombies and skeletons.

item.name: 高级染料
item.describe: 珍贵的材料，高级僵尸骷髅类怪物掉落
item.describe_en: Precious material. Drops from zombies and skeletons.

item.name: 恶魔之血
item.describe: 非常珍贵的材料，恶魔类怪物(恶魔城主，恶魔猎手)掉落
item.describe_en: Really precious material. Drops from demon monsters (demon lords, demon hunters).

item.name: 神秘的藏宝图
item.describe: 冒险家们梦寐以求的藏宝图
item.describe_en: The map of a hidden treasure containing great riches.

item.name: 邪恶地下城卷轴
item.describe: 传送到一个古老而又神秘的地下城
item.describe_en: Teleports to an ancient and mystery dungeon.

item.name: 矿锄
item.describe: 装备后可以在矿山，矿洞中进行挖矿
item.describe_en: Enables you to dig mines after equipping it.

item.name: 高级矿锄
item.describe: 装备后可以在矿山，矿洞中进行挖矿
item.describe_en: Enables you to dig mines after equipping it.

item.name: 幸运药剂
item.describe: 装备后每场战斗物品掉落概率增加100%
item.describe_en: Drop rate of items increases by 100% after using it.

item.name: 经验药剂
item.describe: 装备后战斗经验获得提升100%
item.describe_en: Exp obtained from battles increases by 100% after using it.

item.name: 高级强化石
item.describe: 强化+15以上的装备，主要由深渊获得,挑战副本低概率掉落。
item.describe_en: Enhances equipment higher than +15. Drops mainly from abyss. You have a low chance to obtain it in challenge instances.

item.name: 神秘晶石
item.describe: 极为珍贵的材料,可通过深渊,宝箱,宝箱怪,兑换获得。来源广泛但是概率很低。60级以后可在铁匠铺中合成特殊装备
item.describe_en: Extremely precious material. Obtained from abyss, chests and by exchanging.

item.name: 五一活动金币
item.describe: 用来兑换五一活动装备(限时)。副本,深渊,冒险BOSS(低概率)掉落。(有效期5.1~5.3)
item.describe_en: Can be used to exchange for event equipments (limited time). Drops from instances, abyss and adventure BOSS (low chance). (Effective duration: 5.1~5.3)

item.name: 挑战副本卷轴
item.describe: 进入挑战副本必须物品。可通过合成,黑市获得。
item.describe_en: Challenge Scroll is used to enter the challenge instances. Can be obtained from Blacksmith and Shop.

item.name: 狱岩石
item.describe: 极为珍贵的材料，深渊掉落
item.describe_en: Extremely precious material. Can be obtained from abyss.

item.name: 糯米
item.describe: 端午节活动道具,可用来兑换活动装备(限时)。副本,深渊,冒险BOSS(低概率)掉落。
item.describe_en: Item of dragon-boat festival event. Can be used to exchange for event equipment (limited time). Drops from instances, abyss and adventure BOSS (low chance).

item.name: 神器碎片
item.describe: 分解神器获得,可用于神器升星,洗星
item.describe_en: Can be obtained from divine equipment decomposition.

item.name: 金币(活动)
item.describe: 用来兑换活动道具(限时)。副本,深渊,冒险BOSS(低概率),流浪哥布林掉落。
item.describe_en: Can be used to exchange for event equipment (limited time). Drops from instances, abyss and adventure BOSS (low chance). (Effective duration: 5.1~5.3)

item.name: 金币(元旦活动)
item.describe: 用来兑换活动道具(限时)。副本,深渊,冒险BOSS(低概率),流浪哥布林掉落。
item.describe_en: Can be used to exchange for event equipment (limited time). Drops from instances, abyss and adventure BOSS (low chance). (Effective duration: 5.1~5.3)

item.name: 绿色药剂
item.describe: 非常珍贵的材料，合成获得,可用来加强角色属性
item.describe_en: Precious material.It is crafted in Blacksmith and can be used to improve your attributes.

item.name: 蓝色药剂
item.describe: 非常珍贵的材料，合成获得,可用来加强角色属性
item.describe_en: Precious material.It is crafted in Blacksmith and can be used to improve your attributes.

item.describe: 非常珍贵的材料，合成获得,可用来加强角色属性

item.describe: 非常珍贵的材料，合成获得,可用来加强角色属性
item.describe_en: Precious material.It is crafted in Blacksmith and can be used to improve your attributes.

item.describe: 非常珍贵的材料，合成获得,可用来加强角色属性
item.describe_en: Precious material.It is crafted in Blacksmith and can be used to improve your attributes.

item.name: 鞭炮(活动)
item.describe: 用来兑换活动道具(限时)。副本,深渊,冒险BOSS(低概率),流浪哥布林掉落。
item.describe_en: Can be used to exchange for event equipment (limited time). Drops from instances, abyss and adventure BOSS (low chance). (Effective duration: 5.1~5.3)

item.name: 藏宝图
item.describe: 可根据地图中的线索找到宝藏,据说有很大的概率发现神器装备
item.describe_en: Follow the clues on the map(on the main menu) to find the treasure.

item.name: 藏宝图碎片
item.describe: 可以在铁匠铺中合成藏宝图,可通过兑换,挑战Boss,隐藏怪物,神秘宝箱获得
item.describe_en: Fragments are used to craft Treasure Map in Blacksmith.

item.name: Boss挑战卷
item.describe_en: Can be used to challenge boss.

item.name: 能量之源
item.describe: 蕴含着神秘魔法能量，极为珍贵的材料,可通过铁匠铺熔炼获得
item.describe_en: Extremely precious material. There's a mysterious magic power hidden in it. Crafted in Blacksmith.

item.name: 宠物精魂
item.describe: 可通过放生宠物,捉宠,神秘宝箱中获得 用于提高捉宠概率，喂养宠物提高宠物忠诚
item.describe_en: Acquired by abandoning your unused pets and from treasure boxes.

item.name: 随机副本卷轴
item.describe: 80级以后可用于挑战随机副本。黑市,宝藏,副本,深渊中低概率掉落
item.describe_en: After Level 80 you can use this scroll to challenge random instances.

item.name: 徽章附魔石
item.describe: 用于徽章附魔,铁匠铺中可合成,黑市,宝箱,随机副本中可以获得
item.describe_en: Can be used to Enchant your Badge with new stats.

item.name: 金币箱子
item.describe: 铁匠铺中可合成,用来储存多余的金币。价值1亿金币。(注:游戏金币上限20亿超过后将不会再获得金币)
item.describe_en: Used to store gold. Sell it to get 100 million gold.(Tip: Gold limit of 2 billion at max)

item.name: 经验卷轴
item.describe: 增加50%战斗经验。可持续3000只怪物。

item.name: 幸运药水
item.describe: 增加20%物品掉落,20%金币获得,20%隐藏怪物出现概率。可持续3000只怪物。

item.name: 强效绿色药剂
item.describe: 极为珍贵的材料，合成获得,可用来加强角色属性
item.describe_en: Extremely precious material.It is crafted in Blacksmith and can be used to improve your attributes even further.

item.name: 强效蓝色药剂

item.describe_en: Extremely precious material.It is crafted in Blacksmith and can be used to improve your attributes even further.

item.name: 强效橙色药剂

item.describe_en: Extremely precious material.It is crafted in Blacksmith and can be used to improve your attributes even further.

item.name: 秘药
item.describe: 极为珍贵的药品，试炼,随机副本中可以获得,可用来合成一些高级药剂
item.describe_en: Extremely precious material.It is used to craft potent potions that improves your attributes. Drops from Trial and Random Instances.

item.name: 宠物兑换卷
item.describe: 可通过试炼,游荡商人获得,用于兑换宠物。
item.describe_en: Can be used to exchange for pets.

item.name: 洗练石
item.describe: 可用于洗练装备属性。材料熔炼,野外BOSS掉落.
item.describe_en: Can be used to refine equipment.Items Smelt, Field boss drop it.

item.name: 高级经验卷轴
item.describe: 增加80%战斗经验。可持续3000只怪物。

item.name: 高级幸运药水
item.describe: 增加30%物品掉落,30%金币获得,30%隐藏怪物出现概率。可持续3000只怪物。

item.name: 幻化石
item.describe: 可用于升级幻化等级,冒险中遇到的幻化商人知道怎么使用它。日常副本,随机副本掉落.
item.describe_en: Can be used to refine equipment.Daily Instance，Radom Instance drop it.

item.name: 普通的红宝石

talks: 欢迎来到黑暗传说的世界，游戏中很多强悍的BOSS，大量的装备等待你去征服
还有一些奖励丰富的彩蛋等你去发现
送你一些金币,魔石,点击冒险开始你的游戏之旅吧!
talks_en: Welcome to the world of Dark Legend! Massive fierce Bosses and wonderful equipment are waiting for you to conquer in the game.
There are also large numbers of Easter eggs waiting for you to discover in the game.
Here are some free gold and stones, tap adventure and begin your journey now!

talks: 选择冒险挑战的敌人,击杀当前地图最终BOSS可以开启下一个地图
下面的“-”“+”按钮可以改变挑战的敌人数量，数量越多难度越大，奖励也越丰富
talks_en: Select the enemy you want to challenge. If you kill the final BOSS of the current map, you can unlock the next map.
The “-” “+” buttons are able to change the number of enemies. More enemies you meet, more difficult the challenge will be and more generous the rewards you will finally get.

talks: 失败了不要灰心哦，装备强化,附魔,可以大幅提升角色实力
送你300个强化石，快去角色界面试试吧!还有别忘记装备技能哦
talks_en: Don't give up on your failure. Enhancement and penetration of the equipment can largely increase your character's power.
Here are 300 enhancement stone. Go to the character interface and have a try! Never forget equipment skills!

talks: 恭喜你解锁了技能,点击技能右边的按钮可以装备技能，最多可以同时装备3个技能
战斗时技能会自动释放,合理搭配技能很重要哦
talks_en: Congratulations! You unlocked skill. Tap the right button and equip the skill. You can equip 3 skills at most.
The skills will be released automatically during battles. So it's really important to have the reasonable collocation.

talks: 这里可以获得一些免费的魔石,可以降低一些游戏难度
talks_en: You can go to the app store  rate us or obtain free stones here.

talks: 收集到的材料可以用来打造装备,顶级装备只能通过副本,隐藏BOSS和深渊获得
点击材料图标可以看到材料掉落信息哦
talks_en: Collected materials can be used to forge equipment. Top equipment can only be obtained in instances and abyss.
Drop info can be checked by tapping the material icon.

talks: 通过冒险你会解锁很多BOSS,在这里可以挑战这些BOSS
当击杀特定怪物到一定程度后会出现唯一性隐藏BOSS，难度很大但奖励非常丰富
talks_en: You'll unlock many Bosses through adventure and you can challenge them.
When you kill a certain number of monsters, you'll encounter the only hidden BOSS. It's difficult to handle but you'll get rich rewards.

talks: 恭喜你! 你的实力已经可以尝试挑战副本啦
副本的难度要大一些哦 需要连续战胜3-5个敌人,掉落高品质装备,稀有材料
副本需要消耗副本卷轴进入，BOSS,特殊怪物有几率掉落副本卷轴 黑市中也可获得
送你一些卷轴快去试试吧，实力差距太大时请提升实力再试,别浪费卷轴哦!
talks_en: Congratulations. You're able to challenge instances now!
Instances are more difficult. You need to defeat 3-5 monsters constantly. You'll get equipment and rare materials.
Instances consume instance scrolls. BOSS and special monsters have the possibility to drop instance scrolls. You can also get them in black market.
Here are some free scrolls. Go and have a try. If you're not as powerful as the monsters in the instances, please enhance yourself first. Never waste scrolls!

transmit.name: 宠物试炼之地
transmit.desc: 宠物转生的必经之路！转生的宠物需作为主宠出战！
transmit.desc_en: The only way to pet reincarnation!

transmit.name: 熔岩之心
transmit.desc: 火山内部蕴含着强大的力量!
transmit.desc_en: There is a lot of power inside the volcano!

transmit.name: 神秘海域
transmit.desc: 传言生命之尘出现过的海域！
transmit.desc_en: The sea where the dust of life is rumored to have appeared!
